entries.RULES.admission.assembly: Members may propose to invite people to join the membership, and all members must agree 🏛️.
entries.RULES.admission.pen: Members may invite people to join the membership at will ✒️.
entries.RULES.admission.proposal: Members may propose to invite people to join the membership, and the membership decides ✏️.
entries.RULES.applications.apply:
ƒ (x) => (x.admissionPrice === 'pen' ? 'Anyone with the link joins on arrival.'
        : 'Anyone with the link may apply to become a member.')
entries.RULES.applications.invite: ƒ () => 'New members may only join by invitation.'
entries.RULES.authorship.public: Proposals may not be made anonymously.
entries.RULES.authorship.sealed: All proposals are made anonymously, and all names are revealed at the end.
entries.RULES.authorship.sealedElective: Proposals may be made anonymously, and all names are revealed at the end.
entries.RULES.chamber.closed:
ƒ (x) => (x.founderIsMember ? 'The document can only be seen by members.'
        : 'The document can only be seen by members and the Founder.')
entries.RULES.chamber.link: ƒ () => 'The document can be seen by anyone with the link.'
entries.RULES.chamber.public: ƒ () => 'The document is public — listed and readable by anyone.'
entries.RULES.judgments.after: Votes are revealed when the document is finished, and not before.
entries.RULES.removal.assembly: To remove a member, all members apart from them must agree 🏛️.
entries.RULES.removal.consent: To remove a member, all members must agree 🏛️.
entries.RULES.removal.proposal: To remove a member, a majority of members must agree ✏️.
entries.grammar.commit.bin: Clears your choice and closes — there is nothing here to put back
entries.grammar.commit.binLocked: Close — your vote stays on the record
entries.grammar.commit.cast: Recorded — choose again to change it
entries.grammar.commit.chillOff: Not this one, not now — it stays open and stops being the most urgent
entries.grammar.commit.chillOn: Cooled — this one will not be put at the front of your queue. Press again to allow it.
entries.grammar.commit.choose: Choose one of the three first
entries.grammar.draftFace.sealedLead: This is how your reason will reach everybody else: with your name off it
entries.grammar.draftFace.signed: This is how your reason will reach everybody else: with your name on it.
entries.grammar.fmt.mdMode: Markdown — see and type the characters exactly as they are stored
entries.grammar.ground.sub: the clause changed after you voted
entries.grammar.head.label: The clause as it stands
entries.grammar.head.nothing: Nothing stands here — the charter runs straight from Bringing a Guest to Guests Staying Over.
entries.grammar.lane.pickTitle: Say you prefer this proposal — nothing leaves the card until you submit
entries.grammar.proposeEdit.label: ✏️ propose edit
entries.grammar.proposeEdit.title: Write your own version of this proposal. Free to open — proposing costs one edit.
entries.grammar.revise.lockedTail: This one is settled, so your vote is on the record as it stands.
entries.grammar.revise.shiftedTail: You cannot change it, because it was not a vote about this text.
entries.grammar.speaker.sealed: A member wrote this. Who, is sealed until the closing record.
